title: RetroArch 1.15.0: official development build
summary: RetroArch published 1.15.0 on March 16, 2023. The release record documents an official development build for the multi-system emulator project.

blocks.text: The RetroArch project published version 1.15.0 on March 16, 2023. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The GitHub record does not include an inline changelog. It identifies version 1.15.0, its publication date, and the official release page; those facts are retained here as the complete available release note.
